title: af/ProjectSurveysSettled@2
description: The machine-local record `settled.json` beside `project.lock` of a Project Store (ADR-0159 clause 13). `selected` holds, per collected Survey, the object its collection selected at the Survey's CAS name, recorded under the Store's lock before the Survey's tombstone is appended: recovery follows that device, inode, birth time and length and deletes nothing else, so another inode at the name or in a dead pass's container is `foreign` even when its bytes hash to the Survey ID. `survey_ids` holds the collected Surveys whose own records have left the CAS, deleted at their name or settled from a dead pass's container: collection adds a Survey there under the Store's lock once its record has left its CAS name and before it is unlinked; every later inventory reads it, so a file at a settled Survey's CAS name is `foreign`, sweep after sweep, and only the selected inode is ever deleted from a dead pass's container. Both lists sorted by Survey, each Survey once; no path. Version 2 adds `selected`: `af/ProjectSurveysSettled@1` is a superseded version, refused.

selected.description: Each collection's selected object, by Survey.
